title: License Agreement & Disclaimer
intro: For offline single-player use only. It must not be used in any online mode. Before you start using Apex ("this software") please read all of the terms below. It reads and writes the game process's memory, which is a direct intervention in the game's running state - decide whether to use it only once you understand the risk.

sections.title: ⚠ Offline single-player use only (read this)
sections.body:
1. This tool reads and writes the game process's memory directly - a direct intervention in the game's running state.
2. This tool may ONLY be used in single-player / offline mode.
3. Using it in any online multiplayer match, on an online server, or in any connected mode is strictly forbidden.
4. Memory-modification tools used online are very likely to be caught by anti-cheat, violate the game's terms of service, and get your account permanently banned - usually with no appeal.
5. You bear every consequence yourself: a ban, corrupted game data, lost saves. The author accepts no liability.
6. If you cannot accept any of the above, stop using this software and delete it now.

sections.title: ⛔ Strictly forbidden on official competition platforms (key clause)
sections.body:
1. This software must NOT be used on any official competition, league, ranked ladder, leaderboard, or any online platform with a competitive element, including but not limited to:
     • Low Fuel Motorsport (LFM)
     • PITSKILL.IO
     • Hipole
     • TVRL (Taiwan Virtual Racing League)
     • PXN Pers league (PXN series)
     • FullPush
     as well as their practice, qualifying, race, test and coaching servers, and any affiliated or derived server.
2. That list is illustrative, not exhaustive. Any platform with ranking, lap timing, points, entry review or sporting regulations is out of bounds.
3. Using this software on those platforms means competing with modified car performance - that is cheating. If detected it will normally void your lap and race results, get you banned from the series and permanently banned from the platform, and may implicate your team, your team-mates and team points.
4. Every consequence (account ban, competition ban, erased results, reputational damage, disputes or legal liability) is borne entirely by you. The author accepts no liability and will not assist with any appeal, unban request or evidence.
5. The only legitimate use of this software is offline single-player practice, personal setup research and single-player race simulation. Once you enter any online session - on the platforms above or not - the risk and the consequences are yours alone.

sections.body:

4. You must not use the Software to circumvent any digital rights management (DRM) measure, or to infringe the lawful rights of any third party.

sections.title: 3. Privacy Policy
sections.body:
1. The Software collects, stores and uploads no personal information whatsoever.
2. The Software contains no network functionality, does not connect to the internet, and includes no telemetry, analytics or advertising components.
3. The Software performs only the following operations on your own machine: reading and writing the memory of the game process; storing local configuration under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Apex\ (per-car stock values, a log file, this consent record, and per-car-per-track lap times and fuel estimates); writing back the game's race.ini configuration file when you enable the relevant feature; and, after you explicitly pick race.ini, reading that file only to extract the session lengths used for the lap and fuel estimates.
4. All of that data stays on your own computer and never leaves your device. Deleting the %LOCALAPPDATA%\Apex\ folder removes all local data.
